query: WITH RECURSIVE chain (message, ordinal) AS (SELECT ?1, ?2 UNION SELECT segment_links.target_message, segment_links.target_ordinal FROM segment_links JOIN chain ON segment_links.source_message = chain.message AND segment_links.source_ordinal = chain.ordinal WHERE segment_links.relation = ?3) SELECT message AS "message!: String", ordinal AS "ordinal!: i64" FROM chain ORDER BY message, ordinal
